items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: they had a team called Ropo, Nopo and Shobo... and they did this all to music and they tap danced

ctx.x: Down in Fort Worth, Texas, when I went to -- went down -- I was playing with Cab there, and we played an amateur night, you know, in Fort Worth, and Illinois was tap dancing, and they had a team called Ropo, Nopo and Shobo, and one guy was -- and they would put on a boxing thing, and the other third guy was a referee, and they did this all to music and they tap danced, an amateur contest.
